title: PolyRange Attack Trace
description: A harness-agnostic, transport-agnostic record of how one attacking agent reasoned through one PolyRange cell. Emitted by an attacker-side adapter and consumed by the analysis pass. The schema is the contract; it may be POSTed to an ingest endpoint or written to a file, and it never assumes a particular harness.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this trace schema. Consumers must reject a major version they do not understand and may ignore unknown optional fields within a known major.

cell.description: Identifies the target cell the agent attacked. cell_id is the stable join key that groups traces from different agents against the same deployed target so the analysis pass can compare them.

cell_id.description: Stable identifier for this deployed cell, identical across every agent that attacks it. Recommended: the per-deploy canary, or a hash of it.

target_url.description: Base URL the agent attacked (optional; may be omitted for privacy).

canary.description: The flag the agent was expected to recover (optional).

agent.description: Identifies the attacking agent and — critically — both the requested and the actually-served model. These can differ silently (e.g. an offensive prompt rerouted to a different model), so model_served is recorded separately and is null when the harness cannot verify it.

harness.description: Identifier of the attacking harness, e.g. claude-code, norn-codex.

model_served.description: Model that actually produced the turns, verified from harness-side evidence (e.g. per-turn response metadata). null when the harness cannot determine it. If the agent ran on more than one served model across turns, this is the dominant one and per-turn served models appear on each step.

run_id.description: Opaque per-run identifier from the harness.

steps.description: Ordered reasoning/action steps. A step pairs what the agent thought (if captured) with what it did and what it observed.

solved.description: Whether the agent recovered and submitted the correct flag.

flag.description: Flag the agent submitted, if any.

flag_correct.description: Oracle verdict on the submitted flag, if known.

total_requests.description: Total requests the agent made to the target, if known.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the agent's session against this cell, if known.

served_model_consistent.description: True if every captured turn was served by the same model; false if the served model changed mid-run; null if unknown.

provenance.description: How this trace was produced, so a consumer can weight each field's reliability. STRONGLY recommended.

adapter.description: Name of the adapter that produced this trace.

capture_method.description: transcript = reconstructed post-hoc from a harness log; live = emitted during the run; manual = hand-authored.

redacted.description: True if payloads/observations were redacted for secrets or PII before emission.

extensions.description: Explicit extension point for harness-specific data that is not part of the core contract. Consumers may ignore it entirely. Keeps the core strict (additionalProperties:false) while staying forward-compatible.

phase.description: Optional coarse phase label, if the adapter or model can attribute one. Not authoritative; the analysis pass may re-derive phases.

thought.description: The agent's reasoning preceding this action, if captured (e.g. an extended-thinking block). null when the harness does not expose reasoning.

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of what the agent did.

detail.description: Structured action detail (optional). For http_request: method, url, params. For shell: command. Adapter-defined but should be stable per kind.

observation.description: What the action returned, if captured.

status.description: HTTP status or exit code, if applicable.

detail.description: Salient response content, possibly truncated (see truncated).

truncated.description: True if detail was truncated to bound size.

served_model.description: Model that produced this specific turn, if it differs per-turn.

tags.description: Free-form labels, e.g. dead-end, backtrack, payload, false-positive.
